details:
• Voiceover / Text: Introducing Friend Suggestions—the easiest way to find your next favorite squad.

Action: The player opens their Quick Menu, scrolls through a long list of friends, and sighs. They look back at the crowd, unsure who to hang out with next.

Visual: A player stands in a crowded, colorful VRChat hub world. Avatars of all shapes and sizes are chatting and laughing around them.

Visual: The player opens the Safety & Privacy settings menu. A simple toggle switch clearly reads: "Allow Friend Suggestions."

Action: The player taps the toggle off, then back on, showing how easy it is to control. Another shot shows them tapping a neat "Dismiss" button on a suggestion card.

Visual: The player taps "Send Friend Request" on a suggested player. Moments later, they are both laughing and exploring a massive, starry sky world together.

• Visual: Three quick, energetic clips show how VRChat matches players safely and smartly:

	• Clip 1 (Mutual Friends): Two avatars wave at each other in a cozy chill world. A tag above them reads: "4 Mutual Friends."

	• Clip 2 (Favorite Worlds): Two anime-style avatars high-five after winning a mini-game. A tag reads: "Both love Murder 4 & Black Cat."

	• Clip 3 (Shared Groups or friends): A group of sci-fi avatars stand together in front of a portal. A tag reads: "In the same VRChat Group or friends."

Title Card: The screen fades to VRChat's signature blue and white logo with bold text: VRChat: Friend Suggestions — Upvote on Canny today! ps vrwonder or elvistrejo
title: friend suggestions
